sourceNote: Hans im Glück's online menu (https://menu.hansimglueck-burgergrill.de/, the chain-wide menu with no restaurant chosen; the menu page recorded with its SHA-256) links every item to a page whose "Nährwert & Allergene" view states, for the whole item ("Gesamt") as the kitchen makes it by default, energy in kcal and kJ, fat, saturated fat, protein, carbohydrate, sugar and salt, with no weight. Each row records that page and the SHA-256 of the page as retrieved. An item is one serving of those figures; a drink whose name states its volume ("0,4 l") is that volume, its per-100 ml values derived from the per-portion values and the stated volume. Burgers come with the bun of the house unless one is chosen (sourdough, multigrain, brioche or none); the figures are for the item as the page totals it. The page says the values are calculated and rounded averages of one portion. Alcoholic drinks are left out.
